services.description: List of upstream services to expose via ident2. Each entry defines a service name, host, and port.

name.description: Unique name for the service (used internally and in logs)

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the upstream service

port.description: Port number of the upstream service

server.bind_address.description: Network interface address for the ident2 server to bind to

server.bind_port.description: Port number for the ident2 HTTP management/proxy server

server.max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed

server.tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for the ident2 server (requires cert and key)

server.cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file (only used if TLS is enabled)

server.key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (only used if TLS is enabled)

log.level.description: Minimum log level (debug, info, warn, or error)

log.file.description: Path to log file (empty string to log to stdout)

log.rotate_daily.description: Enable daily rotation of log files
